name: Common Sense
overview: Scripture reveals that true common sense is rooted in divine wisdom, which the LORD generously provides, bringing knowledge and understanding (Proverbs 2:6). Believers are called to trust fully in the LORD rather than relying on their own limited understanding (Proverbs 3:5) and to hold fast to sound wisdom and discretion (Proverbs 3:21). The fear of the LORD is identified as the foundation of wisdom and understanding (Proverbs 9:10), and embracing this wisdom leads to personal benefit, while rejecting it results in bearing the consequences alone (Proverbs 9:12). Genuine understanding manifests in wise speech, contrasting with the discipline required for those lacking insight (Proverbs 10:13).
